title: Compressed-air-operated vacuum generator or vacuum gripper

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: The reference describes compressed-air-operated vacuum generators, not electrically operated ones.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion

features.note: This reference does not mention air baffles or a grip portion.

claims.quote: The invention relates to a compressed-air-operated vacuum generator or vacuum gripper having at least two vacuum units, wherein each vacuum unit has a suction chamber, an intake opening which opens into the suction chamber
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction chamber and an intake opening that opens into it for generating a negative pressure (vacuum). However, it does not mention a 'grip unit' or a 'suction plate' that delimits the suction chamber or an object to be lifted.

overall.why: The reference describes a compressed-air-operated vacuum generator or gripper, which is a related field, but it lacks specific details about the housing, grip portion, electrical operation, sound damping, or specific suction plate structures of the subject invention.
